January 22 38.

H. C. Chen, Esq.,
Chinese Educational Officer, S.M.C.
Manager,
Refugee Sales Corps.

Dear Sir,

Refugee Sales Corps.

With reference to the above and your letter
to the Police Department dated January 17, 1938,
I have to refer you to the Secretary of the Council
to whom such applications should be made.

It should be noted, however, that a similar
application from the General Secretary of the Y.M.C.A.
has been refused by the Council. Your proposal that
house to house visits shall be made is not regarded
favourably by this Department and it is only in this
respect that your proposal varies from that put forward
by the Y.M.C.A.

Yours faithfully,

(Sd) F. W. Gerrard.
Commissioner of Police.

S.1, 特务科 XXXXXXX
报告
日期 1938年1月21日。

主题 难民销售团，教育委员会，国际
红十字会 - 附致上海公共租界工部局警务处之信函。
由特务科督察高延肯（Kao Yen-ken）呈报 经 C. Crawford 转呈。SJ

就附上的1月17日来自天津路37号国际红十字会教育委员会
难民销售团的信函而言，该信涉及其成立及拟在弄堂等地
销售物品之事，销售团销售部主任蔡造時（Tsai Chao-dzu）先生
于1月20日接受问询，经查实，该团的计划与
中国基督教青年会提出的计划完全相同，但该团
打算将其活动限制在弄堂内的挨家挨户访问。待售物品将包括
糖果、洗漱用品和日常必需品。将有
二十名难民承担此项工作。每人将身穿
蓝色背心，佩戴印有该团印章的徽章，并携带装有
待售物品的篮子。

作为试验，该团已与南京路大陆商场（Continental Emporium Building）
的中国国货公司安排，为20名难民每人提供价值10.00元的
货物。关于所得利润，80%归销售员所有，10%归该团
以支付各种费用，剩余10%将存入该团作为偿债基金。

该团尚未派出任何销售人员，在获得警方
许可之前也不会这样做。

以下人员负责销售团的事务：-

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Precis of letter from Refugee Productive & Educational
Translation of Selling Group, No. 37 Tientsin Road.

January 17, 1938.

To
Police Department,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sirs,

With a view to assisting refugees to make
their own living a Refugee Productive and Edu-
cational Selling Group has been organized by the
Shanghai International Commission, China Red
Cross Society with an office at No. 37 Tientsin
Road. Twenty men selected having received their
training are sent out to sell wares etc. in
alleyways etc. from the 19th inst. They will
not hawk or place any stall on footpath. Dressed
in specially designed clothes and each wearing a
badge, they are different from ordinary hawkers
and do not in any way violate your existing re-
gulations. Knowing that you are always ready to
assist and sympathised with refugees we request
you to be good enough to put the matter on your
record and give facilities to these men.

Thanking you for your co-operation.

(Chopped): Refugee Sale Corps, Edu. Com.
I.R.C.

Encl: Specimen of badge used.

销售组来信摘要。

1938年1月17日。

致
上海公共租界工部局
警务处。

先生们，

为了帮助难民自谋生计，上海国际委员会、
中国红十字会组织了一个难民生产教育
销售组，办公地点设在天津路37号。二十名
经过挑选并接受培训的人员将于本月19日起
在弄堂等地销售货物等。他们不会
叫卖或在人行道上设摊。他们身着
特别设计的服装，每人佩戴徽章，与普通小贩
不同，绝不违反贵处现行规
章。鉴于贵处一贯乐于协助并同情难民，我们恳请
贵处将此事项备案，并为这些人员提供便利。

感谢合作。

难民销售团。

REPORT
Date February 4, 1938.

Subject Chinkiang-Tanyang-Kinztan-Liyang-Yungchung Five Hsien
Fellow Countrymen's Association Refugee Camp -
forms Refugee Sales Corps.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford D. J.

A refugee sales corps similar to that of the
Chinese Y.M.C.A., the Educational Committee of the
International Red Cross and the 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation, whose applications were refused by the Council,
is being sponsored by the management of the Chinkiang-Tanyang-
Kinstan-Liyang-Yangchunz Five Hsien Fellow Countrymen's
Association Refugee Camp, 11 Linz Kwei Road (靈桂路), off
Rue Bourgeat.

Ten members have been chosen from amongst the
refugees accommodated in that camp. Each person wears a
vest in the style of a uniform and carries a rattan basket
containing sweetmeats and toys which are for sale. They
commenced functioning on January 25 in streets and alleyways
in the International Settlement and the French Concession
between the hours of 8 a.m. and 11.30 a.m. and between
12.30 p.m. and 4.30 p.m. daily. Members of the sales
corps are allowed to retain 30% of any profits made from the
sales, and the remaining 70% is used as a sinking fund, but
20% is deducted first to defray expenses.

In connection with the above project, no
application has been made to the C.M.F. nor the S.M.C.
Authorities for permission to operate.

Mr. Kuo-Chung-shing (郭仲馨) is the officer in
charge of the Provision Section of the camp and responsible
for the operations of the corps.

档案号............ 8271
S.I, 特务科 XXXXXX 33
报告
日期 1938年2月4日。

主题 镇江-丹阳-金坛-溧阳-扬中五县
同乡会难民营 - 组建难民销售团。

由特务科督察高延肯（Kao Yen-ken）呈报 经 C. Crawford 转呈 D. J.

一个类似于中国基督教青年会、
国际红十字会教育委员会以及第一特区市民联合会
的难民销售团正在由勃艮第路（Rue Bourgeat）旁灵桂路（Linz Kwei Road）11号
镇江-丹阳-金坛-溧阳-扬中五县同乡会难民营的管理层
发起，上述各机构的申请均已被工部局拒绝。

从该难民营收容的难民中挑选了
十名成员。每人穿着制服式样的背心，携带装有
待售糖果和玩具的藤篮。他们于1月25日开始
在公共租界和法租界的街道和弄堂内活动，
时间为每天上午8时至11时30分以及
下午12时30分至4时30分。销售团
成员可保留销售利润的30%，其余70%用作偿债基金，但
首先扣除20%以支付费用。

关于上述项目，未向法公董局或工部局
当局申请运营许可。

郭仲馨（Kuo-Chung-shing）先生是该难民营供应部的负责人，
并负责销售团的运作。
